_why: upstream.py decides whether an OMC update is safe to take without re-applying, and whether the patch can be retired. A false FIXED retires a patch that is still needed. These rows prove the tests notice if it stopped seeing the emission, or stopped treating doubt as UNREADABLE.

mutations.name: exact-emission-ignored
mutations._mechanism: The exact emission line is no longer reported as EMITS; an unfixed build then reads UNREADABLE at best.

mutations.name: respelled-emission-reads-fixed
mutations._mechanism: The loose backstop is dropped; an emission spelled differently from ORIGINAL reads FIXED and the patch would be retired while upstream still writes type.

mutations.name: missing-renderer-reads-fixed
mutations._mechanism: A file whose renderer moved has no emission either; without the guard it reads FIXED.

mutations.name: emits-exits-zero
mutations._mechanism: EMITS is printed but the exit code is 0, so a caller reading only the exit code takes an unfixed build as fixed. Named test is the bundle-only case, where one file emits and the other does not.
